property_summary: For every admissible pair of deposit amounts, the second successful Put must append a second Log.History entry whose Val equals that second amount and whose Sender is the depositor; the mutant, having deleted AddMessage, leaves History empty so this getter read reverts/fails for any input.
change_summary: Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so a successful Put no longer records a log entry observable via Log.History/Log.LastMsg.
